rendered: The out-of-plane ('c' direction) compressive strain imposed on the V2O5 film was compressive strain of 0.5%[1]. The authors assumed a Poisson coefficient v = 0.3[2] and estimated the resulting in-plane tensile strain on the film as in-plane tensile strain of 1.6%[3]. The ratio of in-plane tensile strain to out-of-plane compressive strain is 3.2[4], so the in-plane tensile strain is that multiple of the out-of-plane compressive strain.
